svg.aria-label: How release 46 calls its models. Play 1: the S17 belief model reads the public history in one forward pass and gives a 54 by 4 holder probability table; 64 worlds are drawn from it and any world that makes an earlier follow illegal is rejected. Play 2: the SMV3 net's policy head reads 64 root positions (64 by 833) and returns 54 card log-odds per world; each legal play scores the sum of its cards' log-odds averaged over worlds, and 8 are admitted. Play 3: for each candidate in each world the heuristic finishes the trick, the afterstate is encoded as 833 numbers, and the value head returns one value written into that cell of an 8 by 64 grid (rows candidates, columns worlds); all 512 positions (values) are sent as 4 forward calls (batches of 128); the row means pick the candidate, then tb and dtr. Play 4, in five steps: the belief worlds; each candidate played (on a lead the heuristic finishes trick 1); try each one with all hands face up: every legal play by every player to the round end, keeping the best result for each side (max for the bot team, min for the attackers), with alpha-beta pruning and a transposition-table cache (429,026 positions tried, 173,315 reused); the average over 64 worlds; the best average. One world (here the true ADKY deal) is drawn: the J of diamonds and the ace of clubs both end with attackers on 45, +1 level, and the 5, 8, ace of clubs with attackers on 80, a lost deal; repeated for 64 worlds and 8 candidates the means are 1.797 for the J of diamonds and 1.719 for the ace of clubs. Declare: 64 sampled deals times the distinct (banker, trump) outcomes, PASS included, sent in batches of 128 (this chance: 2 outcomes, 128 positions, one batch); the best outcome replaces the heuristic's choice if its mean is higher; vdef does this at every first-round chance. Bury: up to 64 candidate kitties times 32 worlds, 2048 positions in 16 forward calls of 128; the highest mean wins; 2 s budget.
svg.text: How each decision calls the models
Input → network → output → how the output is used. Shapes are rows × features.
SMV3 net 491ee4bf: MLP, 4 blocks × 165 wide; value head 204 outcomes, policy head 54
S17 belief 763b5e05: transformer, d 96, 2 history + 2 card layers
The belief model proposes the 64 worlds
One forward pass per decision; preparation is capped at 0.25 s; on any belief error the plain history-legal draw is used.
The policy head picks 8 of the legal plays
One forward call. Candidate 0 is the heuristic's play, except under la on a weak-single lead, where it is the strongest
pair/tractor (else the policy's top play). The heuristic's play stays the fallback. div keeps at most 2 candidates of one shape.
The value head fills an 8 × 64 grid, one value per cell
All 512 cells = 512 positions, sent as 4 batches of 128 (4 forward calls).
At ≤ 7 cards per hand, an exact search plays each world to the end
try each one, all hands face up
every play by every player, to round end
Step ③ tries each legal play for every player to the round's end and keeps the best result for each side (max ours, min theirs).
Alpha-beta pruning skips lines that can't change the answer; a transposition-table cache reuses positions already solved.
On a follow the candidate is just played; on budget expiry the value-head pick stands.
ONE WORLD, STEP ③ (HERE: THE TRUE DEAL)
attackers 80 → bot team loses the deal
64 worlds × 8 candidates in 0.197 s (429,026 positions tried, 173,315 reused from cache) · mean J♦ 1.797 vs A♣ 1.719 → play J♦.
The value head at a declare chance (vd; vdef = every first-round chance)
Outcomes = distinct (banker, trump) results of the options, PASS included unless merged; 64 × outcomes positions, batches of 128.
This chance (ADKY record): 2 outcomes, PASS and 2♣ → 128 positions, one batch. vd runs only when the heuristic would declare
or in the final window; vdef at every first-round chance with an option. The best outcome replaces the heuristic's only if its mean is higher.
The value head picks the kitty
2048 positions, sent as 16 forward calls (batches of 128). Each position: bury, then the heuristic plays trick 1.
2 s budget; on expiry or error the heuristic's bury stands. ADKY buried 3♣ 6♣ 6♦ 7♦ 4♥ 9♥ 3♠ 6♠.
